description: This file defines the ConfigSubscriber class which listens to configuration save events in Drupal, specifically handling language configuration changes and triggering container rebuilds or resetting language negotiation components.

classes.name: ConfigSubscriber
classes.description: Handles configuration change events related to language settings in Drupal, updating language defaults, resetting services, and managing language negotiation components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ConfigSubscriber with dependencies for managing language and configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSave
methods.description: Responds to configuration save events, updating language settings and triggering container rebuilds or resets as needed.

methods.name: setPathProcessorLanguage
methods.description: Sets the PathProcessorLanguage instance used for resetting language path processing.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this subscriber listens to, specifically configuration save events.
